Wheat - Megan Youmans

Megan Youmans

2026-09-05

R Markdown

Hypothesis: Will there be a visible correlation between varieties at different sow rates in terms of how much yield they produce? Will certain varieties produce more yield over others and could be an indicator at what type of wheat to plant? Or could sowrate itself be an indicator regardless of variety for yield production? Types of Variables: Numerical values

wheat <- read.csv('/Users/meganyoumans/Desktop/Adelphi Coursework/Statistical Modeling/Datasets/wheat2.csv')
